method.runtime: Minified Rolldown bundles of the same CPU and Wasm simulator sources used by experiment workers; release Rust Wasm.
method.scope: One Node process and one simulation thread per trial. Includes scalar metric collection. Excludes frontend compilation, worker messaging, UI rendering and multi-worker scaling.
method.timing: First experiment is cold. A second experiment warms the runtime; following samples include create + execution. Forced GC is outside timed sections. Engines and case order alternate across fresh-process repeats.
method.memory: Separate fresh processes, one experiment each. Checkpoints follow forced GC. Peak RSS is the process high-water mark through execution, before result hashing. RSS includes Node, code, model and Wasm. external includes arrayBuffers; Wasm linear-memory size is capacity, not an additional RSS total.
method.correctness: All trials compare SHA-256 of every final run snapshot and every metric frame, and assert token conservation and zero errors.
